# librus-shell (LIBRUS)

> Interface freeze **v0.9.9** · **2026-09-10** · see docs/INTERFACE.md
> Multi-flavor study reader: library, four-pane desk, Hypothesis notes, optional JaaS.

Chrome is frozen. Next work is book HTML/CSS and editorial (doutrina-content), not new panes or bar chrome.

## Product hosts

- librus.app — LIBRUS shelf
- doutrina.org — shared Doutrina shelf
- *.doutrina.org — adhered Centers (opt-in)

## App surfaces

- Library: shelf; CTA Ache · Leia · Consulte · Anote / Find · Read · Lookup · Note
- Reader: 1. Ache · 2. Leia · 3. Consulte · 4. Anote
